samples.question: This picture is a 6 by 6 block of square rooms. Every wall is solid ink except where it is broken by a doorway gap, and you may walk from room to room only through those gaps. Eight dots sit in eight different rooms: two red, two blue, two green and two purple. Exactly one colour has both of its dots in rooms that are joined to each other by doorways. Which colour is it? Answer with exactly one of: red, blue, green, purple.
